[PREFERENCE] User is looking for moderate difficulty hiking trails.  
[PREFERENCE] User prefers hikes that are around 3-4 hours long.

[RELATIONSHIP] User will be hiking with a friend.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Max Patch hike on the Appalachian Trail is a 4-mile out-and-back trail with an elevation gain of around 500-600 feet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Max Patch trail is considered moderate, with a few steep sections.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Max Patch trailhead has a small parking lot that can accommodate about 20-25 vehicles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The parking lot is located at the end of Max Patch Road (Forest Service Road 1182).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The drive from Asheville to Max Patch is approximately 45 miles (about 1 hour).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The drive from Knoxville, Tennessee, to Max Patch is around 70 miles (about 1.5 hours).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can do the Max Patch hike as a day trip from Asheville.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can leave Asheville around 7-8 am to beat the crowds and heat.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can expect to finish the hike and return to Asheville in the late afternoon, around 2-3 pm.  
[PREFERENCE] User prefers to stay overnight in Hot Springs to enjoy the town's atmosphere and relax after the hike.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended restaurants in Hot Springs include The Hot Springs Resort and Spa's Restaurant, The Spring Creek Tavern, and Max Patch Tavern.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended cafes in Hot Springs include Artisun Gallery and Cafe and Hot Springs Coffee Company.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Laurel River Store offers snacks, drinks, and souvenirs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can soak in the natural hot springs at the Hot Springs Resort and Spa after the hike.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Reservations are recommended for dinner at The Hot Springs Resort and Spa's Restaurant, especially on weekends or during peak season.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can make reservations by calling the resort or using online platforms like OpenTable.
